issues_confirmed: behavior_pack/items/scythe.json:17-22 - minecraft:weapon.on_hurt_entity fires event 'scythe:hurt_event', which is defined nowhere; the item file has no 'events' block and no other pack file declares it. Undefined event reference on a custom item; leading hypothesis for the recorded 'recipe does not work' failure, since an item that fails to register takes its recipe output with it.

behavior_pack/items/scythe.json - no 'minecraft:icon' component. The only icon declaration is resource_pack/items/scythe.json:9-11, the legacy RP item format. For a format_version 1.21.0 item the icon belongs on the behavior-pack side.
resource_pack/items/scythe.json:2,6 - declares format_version '1.21.0' but uses the pre-1.16-era '"category": "Equipment"' description field. Incoherent schema mix.

TESTING_IPAD.md:13 instructs the reader to download 'scythe_addon.mcaddon' from the repo, but no such file exists, no release has been cut, and .gitignore:11 ignores '*.mcaddon' so it can never be committed. The documented primary install path is impossible.
No build script of any kind in the repo - there is no way to produce a .mcaddon, so the add-on cannot be installed on the iPad the owner intended to test on.
resource_pack/textures/items/iron_scythe.png is 119 bytes, 16x16, and renders as a single thin diagonal stroke - a stick, not a scythe. Confirmed by viewing the image.
resource_pack/models/entity/scythe.geo.json:22-40 - the 'blade' bone is a 2x8x2 cube sitting directly on top of the 1x8x1 'handle' cube. The geometry is a lollipop, not a scythe.

resource_pack/animations/scythe.animation.json - animation.scythe.wield has no keyframes (a single static rotation/position) and no first-person vs third-person split, so the hold pose will be wrong in one of the two views.
behavior_pack/items/scythe.json:41-43 - minecraft:display_name hardcodes the literal string 'Iron Scythe' rather than the translation key, so resource_pack/texts/en_US.lang:1 is never consumed.
behavior_pack/loot_tables/items/scythe.json is referenced by no other file in either pack - dead file.

verdict: Early scaffold, never confirmed working. Structurally sound - manifests, UUIDs, dependency link and texture atlas registration are all correct - but the item definition contains an undefined event reference and declares its icon in the wrong pack, and there is no packaging step, so it has never successfully loaded in-game. Not close to finished, but close to a first real test: roughly one JSON fix plus a twenty-line build script away from being able to validate anything at all. The art is entirely placeholder. Stalled 4 months with the owner's own priority list untouched; the 280-line TODO was likely part of why.
